LanguageData.TMM.Relay.TechUnlockedMsg: Molecular relay technology is now unlocked for research!
LanguageData.TMM.Relay.RaidText: Blinding blue relay flashes crackled near the settlement! A strike team of {1} synths from {0} has materialized right outside your buildings and is moving in to attack.
LanguageData.TMM.Relay.AbductionText: A small retrieval team from {0} has relayed onto the map, targeting {1}! If they seize a colonist, they will relay back to the Institute shortly after capture.
LanguageData.TMM.Relay.GizmoLocalDesc: Instantly teleport all colonists standing on this relay pad to another powered relay pad on the same map. Cooldown: 2 hours.
LanguageData.TMM.Relay.GizmoWorldDesc: Teleport colonists and cargo standing on this pad up to {0} world tiles away as a caravan. Costs {1} advanced component. Cooldown: 1 day.
LanguageData.TMM.Relay.WorldTargetConfirm: Click to launch molecular relay jump here.
LanguageData.TMM.Relay.LocalJumpSuccess: Teleported {0} pawn(s) across the local relay network.
LanguageData.TMM.Relay.WorldJumpSuccess: Molecular relay jump complete: {0} pawn(s) materialized on the world map.
LanguageData.TMM.Relay.FailNotSpawned: Relay pad is not active on a map.
LanguageData.TMM.Relay.FailNoDestPad: No other powered relay pad exists on this map.
LanguageData.TMM.Relay.FailNoPawns: No colonists are standing on the relay pad.
LanguageData.TMM.Relay.FailDestBlocked: Destination relay pad is completely obstructed.
LanguageData.TMM.Relay.FailOutOfRange: Target exceeds maximum relay range ({0} tiles).
LanguageData.TMM.Relay.FailNeedColonist: At least one conscious colonist must stand on the pad for a world jump.
